sloka: वृद्धो अहम् त्वम् युवा धन्वी स रथः कवची शरी ।न च अपि आदाय कुशली वैदेहीम् न गमिष्यसि ॥३-५०-२१॥
transliteration: vṛddho aham tvam yuvā dhanvī sa rathaḥ kavacī śarī ।na ca api ādāya kuśalī vaidehīm na gamiṣyasi ॥3-50-21॥

translations.english: You cannot carry Vaidehi by force within my very sight just as the everlasting revelations of the Vedas cannot be robbed by mere logic of reason.
